methodology: Hand-researched on 17 October 2026 from official sources only: store offer pages, store-published T&C pages and bank offer pages. Coupon codes appear only where an official page published them; nothing was taken from other coupon sites and no code was invented. Every offer records its source URL, the date it was checked and paraphrased terms. All offers ingest as 'unverified' - no code has been tested at checkout.

stores.name: Amazon India
stores.description: Amazon.in is Amazon's Indian marketplace for almost every category - mobiles, electronics, fashion, home and kitchen, books, beauty, toys and grocery - sold by Amazon itself and by third-party sellers. The site runs its biggest promotions during the Great Indian Festival, alongside deal-of-the-day pages, product coupons you clip before checkout, and bank-card instant discounts. Most orders ship with free delivery above a minimum value, and items can usually be returned or replaced within a short window, depending on category. Prices are in rupees and payment is by card, UPI, net banking or cash on delivery.

stores.name: Flipkart
stores.description: Flipkart is one of India's largest homegrown marketplaces, covering mobiles, electronics and appliances, fashion, home, furniture, beauty, sports and groceries. Its offers store gathers live festive-season sales and time-limited discounts across these categories, while newer services bring daily essentials faster - Flipkart Minutes promises delivery in minutes, and the grocery storefront sells at wholesale-style prices. Shoppers see bank-card discounts at checkout and exchange deals on phones and appliances, and the Flipkart Plus rewards programme appears throughout the account area. Prices are in rupees, with card, UPI and cash-on-delivery options.

stores.name: Meesho
stores.description: Meesho is an Indian value-shopping marketplace whose catalogue spans kurtis, sarees and lehenga sets, women's western wear, men's fashion, kids' clothing and toys, footwear, bags, jewellery, home and kitchen products, electronics, watches, beauty and health, grocery and sports goods. Product pages show rupee prices with regular category discounts, and the platform is known for very low price points on trend-led styles. The offers page groups each of these categories into curated collections rather than listing individual codes, so shoppers usually find the best live prices inside the app. Orders ship across India with cash-on-delivery and UPI payment options.

stores.name: FirstCry
stores.description: FirstCry is an Indian baby, kids and maternity store. Its catalogue covers the essentials parents buy most - diapers and wipes, baby care, clothing for newborns through teenagers, footwear, toys and learning products - with a wide range of brands stocked alongside FirstCry's own ranges. The site's Offer Zone promises guaranteed savings on diapers, clothes and toys, with cashback codes, wallet benefits and bank offers, and EMI is available on HDFC, Citi, ICICI, Axis and HSBC cards. Offers include bundle promotions such as a cart deal pairing Mamy Poko diaper purchase with 30% off clothes and shoes. Orders ship across India, and the FirstCry app carries app-only deals.

stores.name: Myntra
stores.description: Myntra is India's biggest fashion destination, with clothing, footwear, accessories and beauty from hundreds of Indian and international brands across women's, men's and kids' styles. Its offers page highlights the season's biggest event sales - such as the Big Fashion Days - and lists coupon codes that drop the price of selected styles marked 'Best Price with coupon'. Shoppers get free shipping, cash-on-delivery options and easy returns and exchanges, and the Myntra Insider loyalty programme runs alongside with points and member perks. Product pages carry sizes, fit details and customer ratings, making it easy to shop across categories from ethnic wear to sneakers in one place.

stores.name: Lenskart
stores.description: Lenskart is India's largest eyewear retailer, selling eyeglasses, sunglasses, computer glasses and contact lenses online and through its own store network. Shoppers upload or scan a prescription and Lenskart fits lenses into frames across budget and premium ranges. The offers page is built around a Buy 1 Get 1 Free benefit for Gold Membership holders and up to 60% off a first order, plus frame-and-lens bundles at flat prices - for example frames with free lenses from around rupees 600. First-order codes and flash coupons appear alongside, making a first purchase the cheapest way in.

stores.name: Nykaa
stores.description: Nykaa is India's best-known online beauty store, selling cosmetics, skincare, haircare, fragrances, bath and body products, appliances, wellness and nutrition, and mother-and-baby essentials, with a Luxe section for premium brands and Nykaa Fashion for clothing and accessories. Its homepage runs a rolling board of offers - festive-season launches, free gifts above order-value thresholds, buy-one-get-one deals and category discounts - plus bank-partner offers such as 20% off with HSBC Taj credit cards on orders above rupees 7,500. New customers get an extra discount on their first app order, and shoppers can browse beauty advice, brand stores and reviews in one place.

stores.name: Croma
stores.description: Croma is Tata's consumer electronics and appliances chain - an omni-channel retailer with a large online store and hundreds of physical outlets. The catalogue spans mobiles, laptops, televisions, cameras, audio, large and small appliances, personal-care gadgets, gaming and accessories, with services like installation, extended warranty and exchange attached to purchases. Online, Croma runs frequent bank-partner promotions - recent ones offered 7.5% instant discount on HDFC and YES Bank credit-card EMI transactions and slab-based EMI discounts with IDFC Bank - plus no-cost EMI and a Privilege programme for members. Store location, delivery tracking and service requests are all managed from the site.

stores.name: Reliance Digital
stores.description: Reliance Digital is Reliance Retail's electronics arm, selling televisions, laptops, smartphones, cameras, kitchen and home appliances, personal-care electronics, gaming and accessories across India. The site runs heavy festive-season campaigns - recent homepage features included 'Never Before Deals on Laptops' with up to 10% bank cashback or six-month no-cost EMI, and an iPhone campaign offering HDFC Bank cardholders 3,000 to 6,000 rupees instant discount on eligible models. HDFC Bank card and PayZapp users are offered a SmartBuy benefit of 5X reward points or up to 1,000 rupees cashback a month, as listed in the site's offer menu, alongside Easy Returns and ResQ after-sales service.

stores.name: Swiggy
stores.description: Swiggy is one of India's largest food-delivery platforms, connecting customers with restaurants for prepared food and beverages, and has grown into a wider delivery ecosystem: Instamart brings groceries and daily essentials, and Dineout covers restaurant discovery, bookings and bill payments. Swiggy One membership includes no delivery fee on Instamart orders above 199 rupees and two monthly Dineout coupons worth 150 rupees each, redeemable against restaurant bills of 1,500 rupees or more. The platform also layers delivery-related fees - delivery, handling, platform and rain charges - which are disclosed at checkout, and additional membership discounts can apply on top of generally available coupons.

stores.name: Zomato
stores.description: Zomato is one of India's largest food platforms, used by millions for restaurant discovery, dining out and doorstep food delivery. Zomato Gold is its savings programme: members get free delivery at restaurants within 7 km on orders above 99 rupees, and up to 30% extra off over existing offers at more than 20,000 partner restaurants across the country. Over 20 lakh foodies are already on the programme, and Gold is joined through the Zomato app, which also surfaces the platform's ordering offers and co-branded credit card promotions.

stores.name: MakeMyTrip
stores.description: MakeMyTrip is a leading Indian online travel platform, covering flights for domestic and international routes, hotels and homestays, holiday packages, trains, buses, cabs and visa services in one place. It brands itself the number-one travel website for flight and hotel booking in India, and runs festive and seasonal travel sales through the year alongside coupon codes and bank-card offers. An example currently listed by ICICI Bank: up to 15% instant discount on MakeMyTrip bookings with ICICI credit cards using code FLYMON. Fares and hotel rates are shown in rupees, and the site maintains an offers hub gathering travel sales and hotel deals.

stores.name: ixigo
stores.description: ixigo is an Indian travel-booking platform for flights, hotels, trains, buses and group bookings, with tools like fare alerts and price predictions that help travellers time their bookings. Its offers hub gathers the discounts currently live on the platform - coupon codes for flights (MONEY, INTFLY, INSTANT, NEW), festive hotel sales like the Great Victory Sale, and a deep bench of bank-card offers with RBL, Federal, IndusInd, ICICI and other banks that add interest-free EMI on top. ixigo assured bookings come with free cancellation and vouchers worth 4,000 rupees. Codes and offers are refreshed regularly on the offers page.

stores.name: BigBasket
stores.description: BigBasket is one of India's largest online grocery stores, delivering fruits and vegetables, foodgrains, oil and masala, bakery, cakes and dairy, snacks and beverages, and household supplies to homes across many Indian cities. Its marketplace now stretches beyond groceries into pharmacy and wellness, food court, electronics and fashion sections. Daily-saver tags - 'Har Din Sasta' - mark thousands of items at reduced prices, and the site runs regular product-level promotions across staples and fresh produce. Shoppers choose delivery slots at checkout, with prepaid payments and cash-on-delivery options.

offers.terms: Bundle promotion shown on FirstCry's offers page: buy 750 rupees of Mamy Poko Extra Absorb diapers and get 30% off on clothes and shoes; conditions are confirmed in the cart.

skipped.item: Offers store, Flipkart Plus page and bank-offers page
skipped.reason: The offers store carries marketing copy and a stale sale FAQ; the bank-offers page returns a 500 error; the Plus page renders account navigation only.
The offers page is category navigation; live deals and coupon codes are shown in-app only.
The site rejects our fetchers at its edge (Akamai 'Access Denied'); no official page, including the offers page, was readable on 2026-10-17. Revisit in the next research round.
The homepage shows only product-level 'Har Din Sasta' price cuts, and the offers paths return almost no content to our fetchers.
